messages:
Maya: @Arthur need a quick capacity change for SpectralAI POC starting Mon. demo expects sustained concurrency spikes, can we temporarily raise autoscale max from 8 -> 24 GPUs for 72h? will cover overage.

Maya: desired window: 2026-04-05T09:00-07:00 to 2026-04-08T17:00-07:00 (09:00-17:00 PT each day).

Maya: config sample:
```json
{
  "pool_id": "dedicated-us-west-2-spectralai",
  "current_max": 8,
  "requested_max": 24,
  "duration_hours": 72,
  "burst_window": "09:00-17:00 PT",
  "reason": "customer demo - high concurrency chat"
}
```

Arthur: @Maya ok we can do a soft resize but need two things before we push: finance signoff for estimated overage (~$3.5k) and confirmation whether they want reserved headroom (monthly commit) vs ephemeral burst.

Maya: Finance already approved covering overage for the demo. They prefer ephemeral burst (no commit) but want a hard cap so we don't blow budget.

Arthur: Got it. For ephemeral burst we set a temporary max + a safety throttle. I can set max=24 and a fallback policy that throttles new sessions at 22 GPUs if cost hits threshold. Does customer want automatic model fallback (to smaller quantized variant) once throttle triggers?

Lina: @Arthur recommend enabling model fallback to the -q4 variant for cost control. Also enable prefix KV cache for the demo workload — they'll see latency gains.

Sam: @Maya FYI we need the team list for pool access (emails) so we can provision ephemeral API keys and IAM allowlist. Also please confirm whether they need logs forwarded to their S3.

Maya: sending list now: jules@spectralai.com, ops@spectralai.com. They want logs shipped to s3://spectralai-poc-logs.

Arthur: cool. I'll create a change request and stage it in the pre-prod queue. timeline: 2h to stage, then a 30m maintenance window to apply on Mon 08:30 PT.

deploy-bot: Change request CR-59812 created by Arthur. Staged for 2026-04-05T08:30:00-07:00. Patch: soft-resize + throttle + fallback to model-7b-q4.

Maya: thanks team :raised_hands: please cc me on the CR updates.

Sam: noted. I'll generate ephemeral API keys and upload them to the SpectralAI shared vault, will post the secret link when ready.

Arthur: one more thing — confirm billing code for cost center so finance can reconcile. Maya?

Maya: billing code SPECT-POC-0426.

deploy-bot: CR-59812 status: scheduled -> awaiting-maintainer-approval.

Maya: all set. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
